question: Minnesota Democratic Senate Primary Winner
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Democratic Primary for United States Senator from Minnesota.

If no 2026 Minnesota Democratic Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Minnesota Democratic party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I've finished searching and am writing up what I found, using only material published on or before 2026-08-01.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. The result will come from the first DFL (Minnesota Democratic party) announcement, or from a strong consensus of credible reporting. The Minnesota Secretary of State's results site is the usual official tally. I did not fetch any results page, since anything there would be dated after the cutoff.
- 2026-07-27: The DFL primary is on 2026-08-11. The leading candidates are Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and U.S. Rep. Angie Craig. [KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/07/27/mn-dfl-race-us-senate-heats-up-primary-approaches/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing had settled the race as of 2026-08-01. It was effectively a two-way contest between Flanagan and Craig, and the question resolves after the primary.
- None of Omar, Ellison, Frey, Hortman or López Franzen shows up as a Senate candidate in July coverage. Ellison appears in KSTP polling for a different race. Melissa Hortman was killed in June 2025.
- 2026-05-30: The DFL convention in Rochester endorsed Flanagan. No other candidate was nominated. [Minnesota Reformer](https://minnesotareformer.com/2026/05/30/lt-gov-peggy-flanagan-wins-dfl-endorsement-for-u-s-senate-seat/)
- 2026-05-27: Craig skipped the convention and went straight to the August primary. [KEYC](https://www.keyc.com/2026/05/27/rep-angie-craig-forgoes-dfl-state-convention-continue-august-primary/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-28: A PPP poll released by the Democratic Lieutenant Governors Association, which backs Flanagan, had Flanagan 46%, Craig 32%. It was fielded July 23-24 among 672 likely Democratic primary voters, and Flanagan's lead was up from 7 points a month earlier. The release says about $20M in outside money has been spent for Craig, from groups it calls crypto- and data-center-backed. Treat this poll as partisan-sponsored. [DLGA](https://demlgs.org/new-poll-flanagans-lead-over-craig-doubles-to-14-points-as-20-million-in-outside-pro-craig-spending-backfires/)
- 2026-07-27: The final MPR debate was held. Gwen Walz, Minnesota's first lady, endorsed Craig. State Sen. John Hoffman rallied for Flanagan and said Craig had asked him for an endorsement while he was recovering from his 2025 shooting. Craig denied this. [KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/07/27/mn-dfl-race-us-senate-heats-up-primary-approaches/)
- About 2026-07-21: A KSTP/SurveyUSA poll had the race tied at Flanagan 40%, Craig 40%, with about 16% undecided. Flanagan was up 4 and Craig down 1 from the prior month. [KSTP](https://kstp.com/kstp-news/top-news/kstp-surveyusa-poll-lindell-tafoya-increase-their-election-leads-craig-ellison-margins-shrink/)
- 2026-06-18: The previous KSTP/SurveyUSA poll, described as the first independent poll of the race, had Craig 41%, Flanagan 36%. [KFGO](https://kfgo.com/2026/06/18/poll-shows-craig-leading-flanagan-in-u-s-senate-primary/)
- June 2026: An earlier PPP/DLGA poll had Flanagan up 7 points (43-36). [DLGA](https://demlgs.org/new-ppp-poll-shows-flanagans-commanding-lead-in-minnesota-senate-primary/)
- 2026-03-30: Backlash against ICE raids was reported to be helping Flanagan among DFL delegates. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/local/twin-cities/2026/03/30/minnesota-senate-primary-flanagan-craig-ice-raids-dfl-endorsement-delegates)

## 4. Base rates
- I did not find a systematic study. DFL-endorsed candidates have usually, though not always, won contested statewide DFL primaries. Well-funded challengers have sometimes beaten them, for example Mark Dayton over the endorsed Margaret Anderson Kelliher for governor in 2010.
- Independent polling was thin: two SurveyUSA polls, moving from Craig +5 in June to a tie in July. The sponsored PPP polls showed Flanagan's lead widening.
- Craig had a large outside-spending advantage, which favors her. The party endorsement and activist energy favor Flanagan.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-20: Polymarket had Flanagan at about 75% to win the MN Democratic Senate primary, based on a pm.wiki wire snippet. The original page now returns HTTP 410, so I could not confirm it. [pm.wiki](https://pm.wiki/uk/news/wire/agg_63f44cba4a6b3800)
- Polymarket market page: [CryptoSlate mirror](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/minnesota-democratic-senate-primary-winner/). Polling aggregate: [RealClearPolitics](https://www.realclearpolitics.com/epolls/2026/senate/mn/2026_minnesota_senate_democratic_primary-8680.html). I could not find a Kalshi or Manifold price dated before the cutoff.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Possible final KSTP/SurveyUSA poll before the primary.
- Late outside spending and endorsements, such as the Gwen Walz-style endorsements seen in late July.
- Turnout among undecided voters (about 16% in mid-July).
- 2026-08-11: Primary day. AP calls and DFL announcements are expected that night or the next day.
